title: Measurement-Budget Allocation in Quantum Learning with Finite-Shot Generalization Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2608.24891v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On near-term quantum hardware, estimating a Born probability requires repeated circuit executions. A quantum learning experiment with a fixed measurement budget $B$ must therefore decide how many distinct training states $n$ to use and how many shots $S$ to spend on each. We study this trade-off for binary quantum classifiers whose measurement operator $M$ is learned from the training data and evaluated with fresh measurement outcomes. We prove a distribution-free generalization bound for bounded, $L$-Lipschitz losses with a sample term of order $\sqrt{d/n}$ and a shot term of order $\sqrt{(\log n)/S}$; under $B=nS$ the two terms move in opposite directions. Minimizing a closed-form surrogate of the bound gives the allocation rule $n^* = 2\sqrt{2dB/\log(4B/\delta)}$, $S^* = B/n^*$, whose bound value is within 0.1% of the exact numerical minimum on all budgets we evaluate, and a worst-case rate of $B^{-1/4}$. translated_title: 具有有限次测量泛化保证的量子学习中的测量预算分配
translated_abstract: 在近期的量子硬件上，估计一个玻恩（Born）概率需要重复执行量子电路。因此，一个拥有固定测量预算 $B$ 的量子学习实验必须决定使用多少个不同的训练态 $n$，以及在每个训练态上花费多少次测量 $S$。我们针对二元量子分类器研究了这一权衡问题，其测量算符 $M$ 由训练数据学习得到，并用新鲜的测量结果进行评估。我们对有界且满足 $L$-利普希茨条件的损失函数证明了一个免分布的泛化界，其中样本项为 $\sqrt{d/n}$ 阶，测量次数项为 $\sqrt{(\log n)/S}$ 阶；在 $B=nS$ 的约束下，这两项朝相反方向变化。通过最小化该边界的闭式代理表达式，我们得到了预算分配规则 $n^* = 2\sqrt{2dB/\log(4B/\delta)}$，$S^* = B/n^*$，在我们评估的所有预算下，其边界值与精确数值最小值的差距不超过 0.1%，且最坏情况下的速率为 $B^{-1/4}$。PennyLane 模拟（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次系统研究了量子学习中固定测量预算在训练态数量与每态测量次数之间的最优分配问题，证明了有限测量条件下的免分布泛化界，并推导出与数值最优值相差不到 0.1% 的闭式分配规则，实现 $B^{-1/4}$ 的最坏情况收敛速率。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the optimal allocation of a fixed measurement budget between the number of training states and shots per state in quantum learning, proving a finite-shot distribution-free generalization bound and deriving a closed-form allocation rule within 0.1% of the exact numerical optimum, achieving a $B^{-1/4}$ worst-case rate.
